rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose term for a thing or condition that helps something happen.

example.english: A steady income was an important enabler of his successful attempt to quit smoking.
example.traditional: 有穩定嘅收入，係佢成功戒煙嘅重要促成因素。
example.jyutping: jau5 wan2 ding6 ge3 sau1 jap6 hai6 keoi5 sing4 gung1 gaai3 jin1 ge3 zung6 jiu3 cuk1 sing4 jan1 sou3

rows.note: Use this for a person whose indulgence helps another person continue a bad habit such as drug addiction.

example.english: By always giving his son money for drugs, he is basically an enabler.
example.traditional: 佢成日畀錢個仔買毒品，根本係個縱容者。
example.jyutping: keoi5 seng4 jat6 bei2 cin2 go3 zai2 maai5 duk6 ban2 gan1 bun2 hai6 go3 zung3 jung4 ze2

rows.note: Use this when the person gives someone formal authority or permission to act in a certain way.

example.english: The director was the enabler who authorized me to sign the contract for the company.
example.traditional: 董事係今次項目嘅授權者，畀我代表公司簽約。
example.jyutping: dung2 si6 hai6 gam1 ci3 hong6 muk6 ge3 sau6 kyun4 ze2 bei2 ngo5 doi6 biu2 gung1 si1 cim1 joek3
